title: Bing Ads vs Google Ads Cost: First-Party Data Study

facts.fact: Microsoft Advertising search CPC across the accounts Hustle Marketers manages ranged from $0.82 to $7.71 over the last twelve months (vendor's own account data).
facts.quote: Microsoft Advertising search CPC across the accounts we manage ranged from $0.82 to $7.71 over the last twelve months.

facts.fact: The Hustle Marketers study title states its CPC data comes from 16 accounts (vendor's own study).

facts.fact: The article was published on October 28, 2026.
